doctrine: Error margin log: localize residual by structural mode, map literature, fix one mode at a time under full S=K(T1+T2+T3). Same residual discipline as multi-domain / MPCORB campaigns. Zero free parameters.

protocol.metric: Kabsch Cα RMSD + distance residual bins + contacts

fix_queue.meaning: Tertiary native contacts missing or false
fix_queue.literature: Contact maps / top-L metrics drive fold quality (CASP; Marks/Sander coevolution; AF distograms).
fix_queue.fsot_handle: F13–F15 + observer tertiary S at Biochemistry D=13; top-L caps; residual-at-interface on contact set.

fix_queue.meaning: Chain topology / domain packing globally wrong after Kabsch
fix_queue.literature: Energy landscape funnel; topology from contact order (Onuchic/Wolynes; Baker).
fix_queue.fsot_handle: MDS is only as good as D; fix contact D first, then sparse polish; multi-start from SS regions.

fix_queue.meaning: Local segments high RMSD after global align
fix_queue.literature: Flexible loops, termini disorder; core vs surface (crystallographic B-factors).
fix_queue.fsot_handle: Segment-wise residual; coil vs H/E different D_eff; do not over-constrain termini.

fix_queue.meaning: Secondary packing / loops at mid separation
fix_queue.literature: Secondary structure packing; loop closure; contact order (Plaxco et al.).
fix_queue.fsot_handle: F11 sheet + F12 regions; SS amp at Chemistry domain; full scalar residual mid-sep.

fix_queue.literature: α-helix rise 1.5 Å/res, 3.6 res/turn; Cα i→i+4 ≈ 6.2 Å (Pauling).
fix_queue.fsot_handle: F10 helix geometry + Chemistry D=8 interface; enforce ideal helix D when p_alpha high.

fix_queue.meaning: Virtual Cα–Cα bond / local geometry wrong
fix_queue.literature: Standard Cα virtual bond ≈ 3.8 Å; local geometry dominates short-range map (Dill polymer; Flory).
fix_queue.fsot_handle: F07 bb + CA_CA seed; do NOT residual-scale sep=1,2 (geometry is hard constraint).
